test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: All birds can fly. Some birds cannot fly. Which of the following conclusions is correct?
solution:
According to the given statements:

Conclusions:

Option 1) All birds can swim → Does not follow (As no relation with birds and swim is given, therefore it is false.)

Option 2) Some birds are fish → Does not follow (As no relation with birds and fish is given, therefore it is false.)

Option 3) Some birds cannot fly → Follow (As some birds cannot fly is given, therefore it is true.)

Option 4) All birds are animals → Does not follow (As no relation with birds and animals is given, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion 3 follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
